description: A lean, athletic adult male orc warrior: tall compact frame, strong but not bulky shoulders, defined waist and long mobile limbs. Bald scalp, angular olive-green face, pronounced brow, small ivory tusks and focused amber eyes. A short muted crimson neck wrap, one restrained steel shoulder plate, fitted dark iron chest armor and carefully strapped brown leather. Nimble veteran rather than a hulking tank. The silhouette should read as agile and disciplined. Textual direction: the restrained green-and-red palette and veteran warrior role of the currently established Orc V4, reinterpreted as a leaner, athletic and bald individual. Do not copy any specific V4 pixels, face, armor shapes or pose. Original medieval fantasy tactical RPG pixel art character, full body, clear readable silhouette at 128x128, expressive face, rich but controlled material detail with deliberate pixel clusters, three-quarter front view, centered and grounded. Both hands empty. No weapon held, carried or sheathed, no shield, no text, no scenery, isolated on transparent background. This is a new individual, not a redesign or variant of any existing character.
